title: TRUMP P7 Lemma-11 Dual-Barrier Lift Gate
purpose: Freeze the first exact P6-to-P7 proof break inside Paper II Lemma 11 and separate its two independent P6-dependent obligations: representative coverage and acceptability. Test the smallest possible repair locally before touching downstream Paper I or making any complexity claim.

primary_sources.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. II. Finding an Excellent Precoloring

bound_locations.representative_use_of_lemma4: Lemma 11 proof: the common Y0 neighbor is invoked by Lemma 4
bound_locations.acceptability_p6: Lemma 11 proof: z-y-s-p-m-n is declared an induced P6 contradiction

primary_sources.paper: Four-Coloring P6-Free Graphs. I. Extending an Excellent Precoloring
primary_sources.observation: The excellent-to-orthogonal machinery has its own P6-dependent technical lemmas, beginning immediately in Section 2. It is a separate future wall.

proved_scoped_lemma.name: P7_CORRIDOR_RIGIDITY
proved_scoped_lemma.scope: Paper-II Lemma-4 hypotheses, with G assumed P7-free instead of P6-free, and with the Lemma-4 cross-edge conclusion failing.
proved_scoped_lemma.statement: The obstruction produced by the Lemma-4 proof is an induced P6 whose shortest seed-path has exactly two internal seed vertices.
derivation: Paper II chooses a shortest y-to-y' path Q with interior in connected seed S.
Different singleton-colored types imply T intersection T' is empty and the interior Q* has more than one vertex.
If both cross-edges are absent and z,z' are nonadjacent, the proof constructs induced path z-y-Q-y'-z' with at least six vertices.
In a P7-free graph the same induced path cannot have seven or more vertices.

minimality.reason: Any violation under the Lemma-4 proof creates an induced path on at least six vertices, and the six-vertex path realizes the bound.

axiom_iv_guard.statement: In the Lemma-11 input scope satisfying axioms (i)-(v), if separate Y0 witnesses z_L,z_R have no common-neighbor collapse and z_L z_R were an edge, y would be mixed on the Y0 edge z_L z_R; axiom (iv) forbids this.
axiom_iv_guard.consequence: The split-corridor obstruction may bind z_L z_R as a non-edge in the Lemma-11 lift gate rather than treating it as an unexamined assumption.

break_A.original_p6_mechanism: For a relevant pair of types, Lemma 4 supplies a common Y0 witness z, enabling a triple (P,M,N) with one middle representative complete to both endpoints.
break_A.p7_failure: Separate attachments may survive as the exact P6 corridor z_L-y-s-s'-y'-z_R.
pass_condition: Every extension of the original seeded precoloring is captured by at least one generated COMMON or SPLIT subcase.
Every generated subcase extension reconstructs an original extension.
Seed enlargement remains bounded by a function of original |S|.
Family construction and discovery are polynomial for fixed/bounded seed.

break_B.location: Paper II Lemma 11, after construction of the representative family M.
break_B.original_p6_mechanism: To prove every member of M acceptable, the proof derives z-y-s-p-m-n as an induced P6 and contradicts P6-freeness.
break_B.p7_failure: The induced P6 is legal in a P7-free graph, so the contradiction disappears independently of whether representative coverage was repaired.
break_B.importance: Acceptability is an actual prerequisite for the later L1/L2 construction; this is not cosmetic.
pass_options: Prove the canonical acceptability obstruction impossible under the enriched COMMON/SPLIT state using only valid P7-free consequences.
Add a bounded descriptor/state that captures every such obstruction, branch polynomially, and restore acceptability exactly.
break_B.fail_condition: Produce the smallest explicit P7-free seeded witness satisfying all upstream axioms for which the bounded descriptor is insufficient to restore acceptability.

stage.name: TRUMP_P7_LEMMA11_LIFT_GATE_V1
stage.input_contract: Paper II Lemma 11 seeded precoloring assumptions (i)-(v), replacing P6-free by P7-free.
lemma11_lift_pass: bounded seed by a fixed function of original seed size

machine_experiment_plan.scope: Only after the source-bound symbolic obligations are encoded; enumeration is diagnostic/falsifier discovery, not authority.
canonicalization: swap of ordered type pair (T,T') when semantically symmetric
machine_experiment_plan.generated_instances: Decorated P7-free seeded instances satisfying upstream axioms (i)-(v).
order: Only if A passes, run acceptability checker.
If B fails, minimize the decorated witness while preserving all upstream assumptions and failure.
Record exactly which additional adjacency/color/list fact separates answer-distinct cases.
machine_experiment_plan.forbidden_use: Finite exhaustive search cannot prove a universal polynomial bound unless accompanied by a valid general theorem.

backend_boundary.reason: Paper I excellent-to-orthogonal machinery independently invokes P6 contradictions. Front-end Lemma-11 repair does not establish backend lift.

symmetry_firewall.requirement: No promoted invariant may rely on arbitrary names of the four colors, a privileged first/second bit, a selected zero color, or an uncanonicalized equivalent F_2^2 coordinate system.

forbidden_inferences: COMMON-or-SPLIT counting remains polynomial => Lemma 11 is repaired.
A finite search found no counterexample => universal lemma.
Observed exponential state growth => an exponential lower bound.
Diagnostic or CI PASS => evidence that P=NP.
A polynomial-size certificate => a polynomial discovery algorithm.
A front-end lift => the Paper-I excellent-terminal solver lifts to P7-free.

required: polynomial-time solve for the repaired scoped object
no hidden NP-hard oracle or exponential enumeration
promotion_rule.total_cost_firewall: T_construct + T_discover + T_solve + T_reconstruct + T_verify <= poly(|G|) with one fixed exponent for the stated scope.

immediate_next_action: Implement a proof-carrying no-repair checker for P7_CORRIDOR_RIGIDITY and the exact Lemma-11 input axioms, then test Subgate A COMMON-or-SPLIT coverage. Do not touch acceptability repair until A is independently established; if A passes, activate Subgate B and minimize the first P7-free acceptability escape.
provenance_note: This artifact refines the v1.0 P6-to-P7 frontier using direct inspection of the full primary Paper-II proof. It preserves a local proof differential, not a world-novel theorem claim and not a resolution of P versus NP.
